candidate_freeze: Record actual source hash and Git commit before final evaluation; never label a dirty source tree with its base commit.

regression.interpretation: previously observed authored diagnostic, not independent heldout evidence

external_transfer.selection: Sort every original _id by SHA256('memory-book-transfer-v1:' + _id), retain first 128, without looking at model outputs; freeze source bytes and selected IDs before scoring.
external_transfer.indexing: Index every supplied context paragraph in its own task chapter, within one project per original question. Question, answer and supporting-fact labels never enter index text.
external_transfer.metric: Original supporting sentence with correct source identity and span; retain and report any annotation unattainable by the strict metric.
external_transfer.limits: External authorship and a new domain test transfer beyond the existing templates, but 128 scoped distractor questions are not broad real-user memory or full-Wikipedia generalization. After the first scoring this selection becomes regression data.
external_transfer.failure_policy: If downloading or validating the source fails, report blocked; do not substitute self-authored cases and call them independent.

policies: historical_whole_page_pack: baseline recall at 100000 characters, expand selected IDs to full pages with the historical common citation header, then apply the common token packer; this policy is a separate legacy comparison
native_excerpt_pack: actual baseline recall at each declared character cap, then rank-order whole-block first-fit token packing
native_token_budget: candidate recall with the same character cap, token cap, tokenizer, scope and limit; include citations and separators in the cap
correctness_gates: Expected query count and exact dataset fingerprint match before any retrieval
No character-cap, token-cap, reported-size, source-span or tokenizer-version mismatch
Every old native block already fitting the same caps remains present in the candidate; compare every query, not only mean quality
Source bytes remain unchanged for the measured worker lifetime
Frozen completed outputs and source/data/runtime identity must match before resuming
reporting: Publish all per-query annotation gains/losses, complete-question gains/losses, category metrics and p50/p95 timings. Separate old native and historical common-page policies. Reject no correctness failures; do not silently discard quality regressions or unsuccessful generation attempts.
timing: Independent sequential worker processes; random query order per repetition; no result cache for core quality measurements; warm OS/SQLite caches; record ingestion separately. MCP startup, first call and immediate repeat use real official SDK stdio and actual response serialization.

generation.status_at_registration: No configured endpoint/model or credentials found; previous HTTP fixtures and prepared contexts are not actual model results.
generation.minimum_valid_run: Explicit actual served model with frozen identity/artifact hashes, paired contexts, same prompt and scoring, measured usage/latency/error trace. A local model must be called and identified, not replaced by extraction fixtures.
generation.full_cost: Record ingestion/index, model-based summaries/observations if used, retrieval, follow-up reads and answer generation separately; absent authentic competitor observer/compression traces remain unmeasured, never zero-cost.
